title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on Matthew 14: the death of John the Baptizer, the five loaves and two fish, and the walk on the sea.

questions.text: What did Herod the tetrarch say about Jesus when he heard the report?
questions.explanation: Herod said to his servants that this was John the Baptizer, risen from the dead, and that is why these powers work in him.

answers.text: That he was Elijah returned to Israel
That he was John the Baptizer, risen
That he was a prophet from Nazareth
That he was the son of Herodias

questions.text: For whose sake had Herod arrested John and put him in prison?
questions.explanation: Herod had arrested John and bound him and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife.

answers.text: Herodias, his brother Philip's wife
The scribes who came from Jerusalem
The multitude who counted John a prophet
The priests who served in the temple

questions.text: What did the daughter of Herodias ask for, prompted by her mother?
questions.explanation: She asked for the head of John the Baptizer, given to her there on a platter.

answers.text: Half of the kingdom of Herod the tetrarch
The release of John the Baptizer from prison
A place beside the king at his table
The head of John the Baptizer on a platter

questions.text: Why did the king command it to be given, although he was grieved?
questions.explanation: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given.

answers.text: Because John had broken the law of Moses
Because the multitude demanded it of him
Because of his oaths and his guests at the table
Because Herodias threatened him with war

questions.text: What did Jesus do when he went out and saw the great multitude?
questions.explanation: Jesus went out, saw a great multitude, had compassion on them, and healed their sick.

answers.text: He had compassion and healed their sick
He sent them away to the villages
He taught them in the synagogue
He asked them for food and drink

questions.text: What did the disciples say they had there in the deserted place?
questions.explanation: They told him they only had five loaves and two fish there.

answers.text: Seven loaves and a few fish
Five loaves and two fish
Twelve baskets of bread
Two loaves and five fish

questions.text: What was taken up after they all ate and were filled?
questions.explanation: They all ate and were filled, and they took up twelve baskets full of what was left over from the broken pieces.

answers.text: Seven baskets of broken pieces
Five baskets of whole loaves
Twelve baskets of broken pieces
Nothing at all was left over

questions.text: How many ate, in addition to women and children?
questions.explanation: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.

answers.text: About four thousand men
About five hundred men
About twelve thousand men
About five thousand men

questions.text: What did Jesus say to Peter after he took hold of him on the water?
questions.explanation: Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said: You of little faith, why did you doubt?

answers.text: Your faith has made you well
You of little faith, why did you doubt?
Peace, be still, and fear not
Come, and walk further with me

questions.text: What did the people of Gennesaret beg him for?
questions.explanation: They brought him all who were sick and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment.

answers.text: To touch the fringe of his garment
To stay in their city seven days
To send his disciples to them
To calm the wind on the sea
